transform: Explicit selected evidence only. User paths replaced; ANSI stripped; token-shaped strings redacted. JSON results summarized per actual file and status, including all failures. Full immutable raw logs/results remain in ignored local eval directory and are bound by SHA256. No private review input packets or CPU profiles included. Publication layout consolidates all selected logs, runner metadata and result summaries into three keyed UTF8 containers. Every selected byte remains and its existing savedSha256 verifies the container entry; no assertions, counts or red observations are removed.
